mapper.select: SELECT s.itemId, s.goodsId, s.goodsType, s.goodsName, s.goodsCover, s.originPrice, s.seckillPrice, s.stock, s.soldCount, s.limitPerUser, s.activityId FROM ( SELECT t.itemId, t.goodsId, t.goodsType, t.goodsName, t.goodsCover, t.originPrice, t.seckillPrice, t.stock, t.soldCount, t.limitPerUser, t.activityId, t.itemSort, t.startTime, t.createTime, ROUND( ( 0.40 * IFNULL(t.soldRaw / NULLIF(m.maxSoldRaw, 0), 0) + 0.15 * IFNULL(t.sellThroughRaw / NULLIF(m.maxSellThroughRaw, 0), 0) + 0.15 * IFNULL(t.purchaseRaw / NULLIF(m.maxPurchaseRaw, 0), 0) + 0.10 * IFNULL(t.viewRaw / NULLIF(m.maxViewRaw, 0), 0) + 0.10 * t.interactionScore + 0.10 * t.discountScore ) * t.timeDecay , 4) AS hotScore FROM ( SELECT i.id AS itemId, i.goods_id AS goodsId, i.goods_type AS goodsType, i.title AS goodsName, i.cover AS goodsCover, i.origin_price AS originPrice, i.seckill_price AS seckillPrice, i.total_stock AS stock, i.sold_count AS soldCount, i.limit_per_user AS limitPerUser, a.id AS activityId, i.sort AS itemSort, a.start_time AS startTime, i.create_time AS createTime, LN(1 + IFNULL(i.sold_count, 0)) AS soldRaw, CASE WHEN IFNULL(i.total_stock, 0) > 0 THEN LEAST(IFNULL(i.sold_count, 0) / i.total_stock, 1) ELSE 0 END AS sellThroughRaw, LN(1 + CASE WHEN i.goods_type = 1 THEN GREATEST(IFNULL(c.sales_count, 0), IFNULL(c.buy_count, 0)) WHEN i.goods_type = 2 THEN IFNULL(b.sub_count, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS purchaseRaw, LN(1 + CASE WHEN i.goods_type = 1 THEN IFNULL(c.view_count, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS viewRaw, CASE WHEN i.goods_type = 1 THEN 0.50 * LEAST(IFNULL(c.rating_score, 0), 5) / 5 + 0.20 * IFNULL(LN(1 + IFNULL(c.comment_count, 0)) / NULLIF(cm.maxCourseCommentRaw, 0), 0) + 0.20 * IFNULL(LN(1 + IFNULL(c.collection_count, 0)) / NULLIF(cm.maxCourseCollectRaw, 0), 0) + 0.10 * IFNULL(LN(1 + IFNULL(c.like_count, 0)) / NULLIF(cm.maxCourseLikeRaw, 0), 0) WHEN i.goods_type = 2 THEN 0.55 * CASE WHEN b.level IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN CAST(b.level AS UNSIGNED) >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE CAST(b.level AS UNSIGNED) / 2 END + 0.30 * IFNULL(LN(1 + IFNULL(b.sub_count, 0)) / NULLIF(bm.maxBookSubRaw, 0), 0) + 0.15 * IFNULL(LN(1 + IFNULL(bs.free_chapter_count, 0)) / NULLIF(bm.maxBookFreeChapterRaw, 0), 0) ELSE 0 END AS interactionScore, CASE WHEN IFNULL(i.origin_price, 0) > 0 THEN GREATEST(i.origin_price - i.seckill_price, 0) / i.origin_price ELSE 0 END AS discountScore, ( CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, NOW(), a.end_time) <= 60 THEN 1.25 WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, NOW(), a.end_time) <= 360 THEN 1.15 WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, NOW(), a.end_time) <= 1440 THEN 1.08 WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, NOW(), a.end_time) <= 4320 THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.92 END ) * ( CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, a.start_time, NOW()) <= 1 THEN 1.10 WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, a.start_time, NOW()) <= 3 THEN 1.05 WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, a.start_time, NOW()) <= 7 THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.90 END ) AS timeDecay FROM osh_seckill_activity_item i INNER JOIN osh_seckill_activity a ON a.id = i.activity_id LEFT JOIN osh_course c ON i.goods_type = 1 AND c.id = i.goods_id AND c.status = 4 AND c.delete_flag = 0 LEFT JOIN osh_book b ON i.goods_type = 2 AND b.id = i.goods_id AND b.status = '0' AND b.delete_flag = 0 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT book_id, SUM(CASE WHEN is_free = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS free_chapter_count FROM osh_book_chapter WHERE delete_flag = 0 GROUP BY book_id ) bs ON bs.book_id = b.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT MAX(LN(1 + IFNULL(comment_count, 0))) AS maxCourseCommentRaw, MAX(LN(1 + IFNULL(collection_count, 0))) AS maxCourseCollectRaw, MAX(LN(1 + IFNULL(like_count, 0))) AS maxCourseLikeRaw FROM osh_course WHERE status = 4 AND delete_flag = 0 ) cm ON 1 = 1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT MAX(LN(1 + IFNULL(b2.sub_count, 0))) AS maxBookSubRaw, MAX(LN(1 + IFNULL(cs2.free_chapter_count, 0))) AS maxBookFreeChapterRaw FROM osh_book b2 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT book_id, SUM(CASE WHEN is_free = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS free_chapter_count FROM osh_book_chapter WHERE delete_flag = 0 GROUP BY book_id ) cs2 ON cs2.book_id = b2.id WHERE b2.status = '0' AND b2.delete_flag = 0 ) bm ON 1 = 1 WHERE a.status = 2 AND (a.delete_flag = 0 OR a.delete_flag IS NULL) AND (i.delete_flag = 0 OR i.delete_flag IS NULL) AND i.available_stock > 0 ) t JOIN ( SELECT MAX(LN(1 + IFNULL(i2.sold_count, 0))) AS maxSoldRaw, MAX(CASE WHEN IFNULL(i2.total_stock, 0) > 0 THEN LEAST(IFNULL(i2.sold_count, 0) / i2.total_stock, 1) ELSE 0 END) AS maxSellThroughRaw, MAX(LN(1 + CASE WHEN i2.goods_type = 1 THEN GREATEST(IFNULL(c2.sales_count, 0), IFNULL(c2.buy_count, 0)) WHEN i2.goods_type = 2 THEN IFNULL(b2.sub_count, 0) ELSE 0 END)) AS maxPurchaseRaw, MAX(LN(1 + CASE WHEN i2.goods_type = 1 THEN IFNULL(c2.view_count, 0) ELSE 0 END)) AS maxViewRaw FROM osh_seckill_activity_item i2 INNER JOIN osh_seckill_activity a2 ON a2.id = i2.activity_id LEFT JOIN osh_course c2 ON i2.goods_type = 1 AND c2.id = i2.goods_id AND c2.status = 4 AND c2.delete_flag = 0 LEFT JOIN osh_book b2 ON i2.goods_type = 2 AND b2.id = i2.goods_id AND b2.status = '0' AND b2.delete_flag = 0 WHERE a2.status = 2 AND (a2.delete_flag = 0 OR a2.delete_flag IS NULL) AND (i2.delete_flag = 0 OR i2.delete_flag IS NULL) AND i2.available_stock > 0 ) m ON 1 = 1 ) s ORDER BY s.hotScore DESC, s.itemSort ASC, s.startTime DESC, s.createTime DESC LIMIT #{limit}
